pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: A bug fix with one obvious design. The change does what the PR says: a search with no matches says no item matches it, and an empty table still says 'No items yet.'. Nothing extra was added.
There is no spec file in this change.

New tests cover the no-match message, escaping of the search, and the empty-table case. The first two fail against the old code. The empty-table test deletes all rows, as the existing test in index.test.js does. I could not run the suite here because vitest is not installed. CI is declared to run the tests.
No docs mention the empty-state text, so none are stale.

The extra COUNT query only runs when a search finds nothing. The message is HTML-escaped. The page template inserts the message unescaped, but every caller passes a constant or an already-escaped string.
The search term is escaped before it goes into the message. I found no injection or secrets issues.
The change only alters one text string in server-rendered HTML. It adds no UI structure or styling.
The change only alters one text string in server-rendered HTML. It adds no UI flow, and no browser was available.
The title is 51 characters and describes the observable change. The claims about the code, tests and behaviour match the diff.
